Header SHA-256: c32873a9416d925f348bc559d87ea028238b9dba7db3bac052cb1460ac9fa25d
License: MIT, reproduced in LICENSE. Upstream THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES is retained
for provenance; the benchmark, examples, fixtures and their dependencies are
not included or linked. The library is a C++ port of mapbox/delaunator.

Paleo's caller supplies unique finite XY points, normalizes coordinates, rejects
conflicting depths at duplicated XY positions, and bounds accepted triangle
edges. The triangulation is opt-in; no extrapolation outside accepted triangles
is performed. A maximum edge does not recover source fault or polygon topology.
